cover.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE new photographic background for a DearBody Philippines Facebook Page cover. Landscape 16:9, at least 1792x1008, a polished commercial lifestyle photoshoot, realistic Filipino people, warm inviting daylight, joyful relaxed energy and tactile real materials. No overlay text or logos. The physical perfume bottle labels are the ONLY text.

COMPOSITION: Deliberately compose TWO separate real lifestyle vignette areas at the outer edges, connected by a calm plain warm-cream plaster wall in the CENTRAL 44 percent of the picture (x28% to x72%). This large central cream wall is empty, evenly illuminated, with only very soft shadows, reserved for later typesetting. No people, hands, props, lines, plants or products in that center field. Make the shot look like a carefully built real campaign set, not a digital collage; one shared warm daylight direction.
LEFT x0-28%: One adult Filipino woman with natural warm-brown skin and dark shoulder-length wavy hair, easy laughing expression, wearing a sunflower yellow cotton tee, sitting at a coral-red cafe bench. She holds the small capped MOJITO METALLIQUE perfume upright close to her chest and naturally turns slightly inward. Complete face, bottle, hand and cap must fit between x8%-26%, with face around y32%, bottle y53%. Cream/WHITE label, black exact MOJITO METALLIQUE lettering, golden-yellow liquid, glossy all-black cap. This is the women's product; only this woman touches it. A cropped cafe doorway or bright tropical greenery at far left, no mirror.
RIGHT x72-100%: One adult Filipino man with warm medium-brown skin, short textured black hair and an approachable smile, wearing a cobalt-blue cotton tee, casually seated on a coral bench near a burgundy canvas bag. He holds the small capped OUD MIRAGE perfume upright at chest level. Complete face, bottle, hand and cap fit between x74%-92%, face y32%, bottle y53%. BLACK label, white exact OUD MIRAGE wording, vivid blue liquid, glossy all-black cap. This is the men's product; only this man touches it. Cropped leafy greenery at far right. He and the woman are independent portraits for their respective product lines, no exchange or gifting and no physical contact.

Input image 1: authoritative reference for the MOJITO METALLIQUE bottle identity only. Input image 2: authoritative reference for OUD MIRAGE bottle identity only. Do NOT include canisters. Copy accurate tall straight cylindrical glass bodies with thick clear bases, restrained rounded shoulders, narrow necks and fitted glossy black cylindrical caps. The cap has no silver lower edge; any visible silver belongs to the bottle neck. Real small 50ml scale, about one palm length; not large props. Names, label colors and liquid colors must never swap. Labels readable and face the camera; fingers grip unprinted glass below or at side of label.

Keep both people's full hair within canvas with 12% top headroom. Show head through waist; keep all critical faces/products inside y20%-70% so a shallow horizontal cover crop remains usable. Soft but crisp editorial camera, natural skin pores, expressive but plausible gestures, bright daylight with subtle flash fill; no airbrushed/plastic skin. Brand palette cream #f4e3cb, coral/red, warm tan, a little burgundy #5c0006, sunflower and cobalt in wardrobe. No giant bottles, floating objects, fantasy architecture, extra people, other faces, mirrors, crowds, text signs, illustrations, panels, generated headings, UI, borders or watermark.

profile.method: Reframe supplied official high-resolution PH monogram artwork in a square canvas, preserving original logo geometry and burgundy photographic texture.
